text.tspan: 3 | Prediction transfers; local S/T capacity persists
S/T retention at two spatial scales
A: Archived transfer estimates and protein-bootstrap CIs; dashed line is the archived 0.80 benchmark. B/C: Ortholog S/T availability at human O-GlcNAc site
anchors, not measured ortholog modification. Local means ±5 human residues mapped through the alignment. B: Observed fractions. C: Archived paired protein-
bootstrap intervals; cohorts differ by species. A wider window offers more opportunities, so the gap alone is not evidence of selection. Model and null
comparisons are retained in supporting evidence.
